text:
Elaine (Product): Quick sync — proposing a trimmed Visibility MVP: 1) dashboards (latency, error rate, cost-per-route) 2) lightweight trace hooks (top slow traces + headers) 3) a cost-slicer widget (per-model token + prefix cache hit). Goal: ship to pilot customers in 2 weeks.
Sam (Eng): Sounds reasonable but we need to be explicit about sampling strategy for traces. Full traces at production qps = no. Propose adaptive sampling + tail-capture.
Marta (SRE): Agree with Sam. Also need to confirm storage retention and retention costs. If we keep full spans for 7d that explodes. Suggest 72h for pilot.
Raj (Design): UI question: cost-slicer — do we show absolute dollars or normalized units? Customers ask for both. Can we default to normalized and allow toggle?
Asha (PMM): Pilot customers requested currency for billing teams. Toggle would be ideal but not required for MVP.
Elaine (Product): Good calls. Proposal to cut scope: toggle -> later. MVP shows normalized units + sample dollar estimate in tooltip. Sampling: start with 1% baseline, increase to 5% for error traces and top 1% latency. Retention: 72h.
Sam (Eng): Implementation notes: we can wire trace hooks at the request router with a small filter. Pseudocode: ```
// trace-hook sampling policy
if (error) sample = 100%
else if (latency > p99_threshold) sample = 5%
else sample = 1%
emit(span)
```
Sam (Eng): Also need a lightweight schema for the span to avoid blowing up index sizes. Keep fields: trace_id, span_id, route, model, latency_ms, error_code, token_count, kv_cache_hit.
Marta (SRE): For dashboards we need to surface cost hot paths. Suggest adding a derived metric: cost_per_1000_tokens per route. That can be computed from token_count * model_unit_cost.
Raj (Design): Wireframes attached (link): https://figma.com/s/redwood/visibility-mvp — simple tiles + expandable trace list. UX decision: default to route-level view, drill to trace rows.
Elaine (Product): Acceptance criteria (MVP pilot):
- Dashboards: route-level latency (p50/p95/p99), error rate, cost_per_1000_tokens (normalized).
- Traces: captured spans per sampling policy, ability to filter by route/model/error_code.
- Cost-slicer widget: shows token distribution across models and prefix cache hit rate.
- Retention: trace/spans retained 72h; metrics retained per existing metrics policy.
- Launch checklist: migration note for customers with custom telemetry config, smoke test against sample workload, runbook entry for oncall.
Sam (Eng): Timeline: 2 sprints if we keep scope. Spike this week for storage estimate + schema. Can we re-use existing metrics pipeline for the route tiles? If yes, big win.
Marta (SRE): We should not reuse metrics pipeline for traces. But route metrics should come from existing metrics ingestion — yes. Traces go to a new lightweight ES index or clickhouse table. I'll run cost calc if Sam posts estimated bytes/span.
Elaine (Product): Decision: keep dashboards + trace sampling + cost-slicer (no currency toggle, no multi-tenant deep breakdown). Can we commit to pilot rollout by EOW + 2 weeks?
Sam (Eng): EOW pilot flag ready (feature flag + basic UI). Full telemetry ingestion + storage ready in Sprint 2. :thumbsup:
Raj (Design): I'll adjust wireframes to remove currency toggle and add tooltip for dollar-estimate.
Asha (PMM): I'll prep pilot notes and customer-facing FAQ.
visibility-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Visibility MVP kickoff" tomorrow 09:00 PT.
Elaine (Product): Follow-ups: Sam — post spike results (bytes/span + cost estimate) by Wednesday; Marta — retention/cost calc by Thursday; Raj — updated wireframes by Thursday COB. I'll update roadmap doc and notify pilot customers. :eyes:
Sam (Eng): Will do. Posting early spike notes here later.
Marta (SRE): I'll publish storage numbers and potential mitigations (compress spans, drop args)
Elaine (Product): Great. If no objections, locking scope as discussed. :white_check_mark:
